title: Pin federation operator follow-up refusal after unresolved settings persistence
outcome: The failed-persistence HTTP regression pins the operator-visible attempted settings and the held 409 follow-up without permitting another mutation while durability is unresolved.
acceptance: The existing real SQLite failed-write operator test asserts the GET enabled/role/central values for the attempted in-memory settings, trackingDurability unresolved, held admission and unchanged durable image.

After removing the fixture write failure, a follow-up settings POST returns 409 while durability is unresolved, and both pending in-memory domain image and stored image remain unchanged; the test discriminates an improper fresh write from the existing hold.
The focused operator and federation regression checks pass on the final source revision, with the maintained gate and required review before landing.
